note: Family-run resort on Whitlock Bay of Lake Oahe, ~15 mi W of Gettysburg on US-212: RV lanes between old shelterbelt tree rows, next to a summer mobile-home community, with motel and cabins, picnic shelter, playground and a boat launch. Walleye-fishing destination. --Claude
summary: Operator page: 71 full-hookup sites, $42/day (tents $25), monthly rates available, showers, laundromat; Book Now is a contact form -> platform phone. Phone empty -> (605) 765-9762. Price passes. Google 4.7/32. Season unposted. Long-stay: monthly offered and a separate summer mobile-home community, but the RV lanes look transient. Not waterfront; pin fine.
flags: PRICE GATE: passes - $42/day full hookup (operator page, undated, 'Rates subject to change'; same figure as read 2026-10-16). One rate all season. No gateway needed.
GOOGLE: 4.7 stars over 32 reviews (resort listing shared with motel/cabins/store, not the campground alone). Review text could not be read (headless review panel did not load).

On summer imagery the shelterbelt RV lanes held about a dozen RVs among many empty pedestals, consistent with nightly use. Nightly share not measurable; passes the five tests as read.
